# How to connect your systeme.io account to Claude using MCP keys

In this article, you will learn how to integrate the [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) MCP server with Claude so you can interact with your account data using AI.

What you will need:

- A[systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account
- An MCP key generated from your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol](https://help.systeme.io/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d))
- A Claude account (The feature is available for all plans)

You can connect [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) to Claude using their Connectors feature. This works on [Claude.ai](http://Claude.ai) (Web), the Claude desktop app, and Claude mobile apps.

To do so, log in to your Claude account; on the left panel, select **Customize** (1).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-1wW6nbmPTvqqlVyNZ06hSV9g3k1SEy.png)

Then select **Connectors** (2).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-9aBG2ASpyrnEepB7JFoHzH7KYxIGzK.png)

Click **Add** (3), then click **Add custom connector** (4).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-oDjhssmBdA3MZPx8qOVQdjAWp7mlLE.png)

In the setup popup, enter the following details:

- **Name** (5)**:** [systeme.io](http://systeme.io)
- **Remote MCP server URL** (6)**:** [https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY](https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY)

> **Note:** Replace YOURMCPKEY with the **MCP key you created on your** [**systeme.io**](http://systeme.io)** account.**

Click on **Continue** (7).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-IBKFL8d20tgeZ98ZphevqNpcmX3bhb.png)

Select **No sign-in** (8) under Authentication, and click **Add** (9).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-8HFyNbYDbnBZHcKAXbBipPKGHMbfG5.png)

Once connected, you'll see the [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) connector panel with a list of tools Claude can use on your behalf. These are divided into two categories:

**a. Read-only tools** (10): These let Claude retrieve information from your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account without making any changes (more options are available as you scroll).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-GtWLigOWhKmRX2SgNrhwAVXpkCo0ro.png)

**b. Write/delete tools** (scroll further down) (11): These allow Claude to create, update, or delete data in your account (more options are available as you scroll).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-lzIDv2OVLTpL8SfE2cBJIFm8uL00pi.png)

For each tool, you can choose one of three permission levels that will apply to all the tools:

- Always allow (12)
- Needs approval (13)
- Blocked (14)

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-d8Xl91Tm5iHN7CAyIpLw9CSC7TkJsi.png)

- Custom (15): Each tool can be configured individually according to your preference.

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-MNqivoMhQ666V5uBY72KH7RufQoZlE.png)

Once connected and all set, click the **+** button in the chat input, select **Connectors**, and toggle [**systeme.io**](http://systeme.io) on. Claude will now have access to your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account in this conversation.

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-381fPH2QDhH1WKLGj6PtORsiC1NoC6.png)

To learn more about Claude connectors and how they can extend Claude's capabilities, see the official guide: [Use connectors to extend Claude's capabilities](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11176164-use-connectors-to-extend-claude-s-capabilities).
